tags.name: EruptExcelController
tags.description:
Import and export in any registered TableCodec format.

The path keeps its historical "excel" segment and Excel stays the default, so a client that
sends no format sees no change.

tags.name: EruptApi
tags.description: Framework level endpoints that need no session.

tags.name: EruptModifyController
tags.description: Write side of erupt data: insert, update, delete and ordering.

tags.name: EruptGanttController
tags.description:
Writes made from the gantt view.

Bar drags change the dates, link drags change the predecessors declared by
GanttView.dependencyField. Both run the DataProxy update hooks and publish EruptEditEvent
with the pre-change copy, so the operation log and other modules see them like any edit.

tags.name: EruptUserController
tags.description: Session lifecycle and the signed-in user: login, logout, profile, menu.

tags.name: EruptToolController
tags.description: Developer tools exposed to the admin UI.

tags.name: EruptBoardController
tags.description: Writes made from the board (kanban) view.

tags.name: EruptCalendarController
tags.description: Writes made from the calendar view.

tags.name: EruptDataController
tags.description: Read side of erupt data: table, tree, detail, reference pickers and row operations.

tags.name: EruptTplController
tags.description: Server rendered template pages. These answer HTML, not JSON, and take the token as the _token query parameter.

tags.name: EruptFormViewController
tags.description:
Form view: a standalone form whose loading and saving belong entirely to the user.

The framework only renders the form schema and routes the two lifecycle moments,
DataProxy.formViewBehavior and DataProxy.formSave, to the DataProxy. Loading the data and
persisting it are the user's responsibility: a database, a file, an external API, anything.
Field-level validation and the DataProxy.validate hook are reused because they are
data-source-agnostic by nature.

tags.name: EruptOpenApiController
tags.description: Token exchange for server-to-server callers registered as Open API apps.

tags.name: EruptMfaController
tags.description:
Self service endpoints for binding and removing a TOTP authenticator.

Every route here requires an authenticated session; the login side of MFA lives in
EruptUserController (login and login-mfa).
